en.name: ClipReady
en.intro: How this version handles data, its usage terms and how to contact us.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: Where data is processed, retained and removed.

sections.title: 1. Provider
paragraphs: ClipReady is provided by 北京晓目标科技有限公司. Privacy contact: lusanyuss@gmail.com. It is an offline video compression and conversion app.

sections.title: 2. Videos and task records
paragraphs: Selected videos are processed on your device. ClipReady copies selected originals into its private storage so tasks can be retried and stores local task history, output details and preferences. It does not upload videos or task records to an app server.

sections.title: 3. Device and system services
paragraphs: The system picker may download cloud-hosted media before the app receives it. Saving to Photos, exporting to Files and sharing use the system service or destination you select. Their network access and policies apply. Files and outputs remain local until you choose to export or share them.

sections.title: 4. Optional Google services
paragraphs: No registration is required to compress or export videos. Service-enabled Android releases may use Google AdMob and its consent platform to show banners on Home, Exports, Results and Settings, and frequency-limited interstitials when returning home after successful batches. The advertising SDK can process IP-derived approximate location, app interactions, device or advertising identifiers, and diagnostic information for advertising, measurement and fraud prevention. Advertising privacy choices are provided when required. A verified one-time ad-removal purchase stops ad requests and removes all ad space. Ad requests use general-audience (G) filtering, non-personalized advertising and the SDK's restrictive consent-age treatment for all users. We do not collect birthdays or assume every user is an adult.

Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics are separate choices, both off by default. Analytics can process usage events, installation identifiers, device/app information and approximate location derived by the SDK. Crashlytics processes crash, performance and diagnostic information and installation identifiers. Our custom events exclude media, filenames, paths, feedback text, emails and purchase tokens. Our Dart error reporting redacts error messages. You can stop future optional collection in Settings; this does not automatically erase previously submitted data.

Google Play handles checkout and payment details. Purchasing and restoring use your Google Play purchasing account; there is no app registration or sign-in. The app receives purchase state and signed receipts, validates them on the device and keeps a private verified entitlement cache for offline startup. It does not receive your payment-card details. Successful store refreshes can revoke a refunded or cancelled entitlement; offline devices cannot detect refunds in real time. There is no subscription or server-side purchase-verification system in this release.

sections.title: 5. Text feedback
paragraphs: Feedback is sent only after you enter text, agree to the listed upload details and press Send. The app creates a private anonymous Firebase Authentication identifier and writes your message, category, submission ID, app version/build, operating system and language to Cloud Firestore. This technical identifier is not an app sign-in or the source of purchase entitlements. Authentication and network services may process IP addresses and device/network information. You do not have to register, provide an email address or attach files. Do not include private information or video content.

Only a server-confirmed transaction is shown as received. If the network result is uncertain, a local draft and stable submission ID allow a safe retry. Keep the displayed Feedback ID for support or deletion requests. The client cannot enumerate other feedback, modify submitted feedback or delete server records directly.

sections.title: 6. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local task records and app-owned copies are managed using the app controls. Camera originals and exported copies are separate. Uninstalling removes app-private storage subject to platform behavior; save wanted outputs first.

Feedback is intended to be removed after handling and within 180 days. In the Spark implementation this is an operator-managed deletion process, not an automatic expiry job. Anonymous authentication records also require operator review and deletion. Contact lusanyuss@gmail.com with the Feedback ID and approximate date for a deletion request; do not send purchase tokens or private videos. Do not assume uninstalling deletes cloud feedback.

Analytics event and user data retention is set to 2 months, without resetting the retention period on new activity. Google Signals, granular location/device collection and advertising personalization are disabled for this property. Crashlytics, AdMob, Google Play and support email retain information under their respective policies and configured settings.

sections.title: 7. Providers, transfers and contact
paragraphs: Google services may process data on infrastructure outside your country. Feedback is stored in Cloud Firestore in the nam5 North America multi-region. Encryption in transit is provided by the service SDKs. We do not upload your media for compression or require device-location access.

This static website contains no app SDK, analytics scripts or feedback forms; GitHub Pages handles its own hosting/network logs. Privacy contact: lusanyuss@gmail.com. Provider: 北京晓目标科技有限公司. Updated 2026-10-30. This policy describes the service-enabled Android offering; local candidates explicitly marked unconfigured do not make unavailable services operational.

sections.title: 8. Age and optional services
paragraphs: ClipReady is intended for users aged 13 and over, not children under 13. All local compression features remain free and available without registration, telemetry or feedback submission. Optional Analytics and Crashlytics require a separate confirmation that the user is at least 18 before enabling either service. Text feedback also requires confirmation of age 18 or over and agreement to the listed upload details. Users under 18 should leave these optional services off. Google Play applies its own account, purchase and parental-approval rules. If you believe information from an underage user was submitted, contact lusanyuss@gmail.com with the Feedback ID or relevant date so we can investigate and remove records we control. Do not send identity documents, private videos or payment tokens.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.summary: Service scope, usage rules and current billing status.

sections.title: 1. Service
paragraphs: Use the app only for media you own or have permission to process, save and share. Respect the source service’s terms. Links, supported formats and device capabilities can change.

sections.title: 2. Local files
paragraphs: Keep backups of important files. Processing may change size, quality, metadata or compatibility. Review the result before discarding originals. Local results are not a cloud backup.

sections.title: 3. Charges and availability
paragraphs: The app is free to download and all local compression features remain free. Service-enabled Android releases can offer a one-time non-consumable purchase to remove all advertising; there is no subscription. The store shows the local price and asks for confirmation before payment. Pending payments do not grant ad removal. Restore uses the current Play account. Refunds and revocations are reflected on successful store refresh, not in real time while offline. Availability depends on actual store configuration and region.

sections.title: 4. Contact and updates
paragraphs: For support or privacy requests, contact lusanyuss@gmail.com. We update these documents when the service or data processing changes.

deletion.title: Manage your data
deletion.summary: Manage local data, optional data collection and support requests.

sections.title: Local data
paragraphs: The app does not provide registration or sign-in. Use the app to manage local records and app-owned files. Anonymous feedback creates a private cloud identifier and submitted text, which are separate from local files. Uninstalling does not delete that feedback.

sections.title: Access and requests
paragraphs: To stop optional Analytics or Crashlytics collection, turn off the separate switches in Settings. To request deletion of feedback or support correspondence, email lusanyuss@gmail.com with the Feedback ID and approximate date. Do not send passwords, purchase tokens or private media. We review requests against the data we actually hold. Play purchase records and Google-held SDK data are also subject to Google controls and policies.

sections.title: Contact us
paragraphs: Email lusanyuss@gmail.com with the problem, device model, OS and app version, and reproduction steps.
Do not send passwords, verification codes, cookies, identity tokens or unnecessary private media. Email is sent only when you choose; the app does not automatically upload diagnostics.

zh.name: 视频轻装 · ClipReady
zh.intro: 了解本版的数据处理、使用规则和联系渠道。

privacy.title: 隐私政策
privacy.summary: 数据在何处处理，如何保留和清理。

sections.title: 1. 服务提供者
paragraphs: 视频轻装（ClipReady）由北京晓目标科技有限公司提供。隐私联系邮箱：lusanyuss@gmail.com。本应用提供离线视频压缩与转换。

sections.title: 2. 视频与任务记录
paragraphs: 选择的视频在设备上处理。为便于重试，应用将选中原片复制到私有目录，并在本机保存任务历史、输出信息和设置；不会将视频或任务记录上传到应用服务器。

sections.title: 3. 系统服务
paragraphs: 系统选择器可能先下载云端媒体，再将文件交给应用。保存相册、导出文件和分享使用你选择的系统服务或目标应用，它们的网络访问和政策适用。视频与结果保留在本机，直到你主动导出或分享。

sections.title: 4. 可选 Google 服务
paragraphs: 压缩和导出无需注册。启用服务的 Android 版本可使用 Google AdMob 及其同意管理平台，在首页、导出记录、结果和设置展示横幅，并在成功完成批次后返回首页时展示有频率限制的插屏。广告 SDK 可处理由 IP 推导的大致位置、App 交互、设备或广告标识及诊断信息，用于广告、衡量和防欺诈；按要求提供广告隐私选项。已验证的一次性去广告购买会停止广告请求并移除全部广告占位。 所有广告请求统一采用G级内容过滤、非个性化广告及SDK更严格的同意年龄保护，不采集生日，也不假定每位用户已成年。
Firebase Analytics 与 Crashlytics 分别选择，首次默认关闭。统计 SDK 可处理使用事件、安装标识、设备及 App 信息和由 SDK 推导的大致位置。崩溃服务处理崩溃、性能与诊断信息及安装标识。自定义事件不包含媒体、文件名、路径、反馈正文、邮箱或购买令牌；Dart 错误报告会隐去异常正文。你可在设置中停止后续可选采集，这不自动删除此前已提交的数据。
Google Play 处理结账和付款资料。购买和恢复使用 Google Play 购买账号，App 不提供注册或登录。App 接收购买状态及签名回执，在设备上验证并保存私有权益缓存，以便离线启动。App 不接收银行卡资料。成功刷新商店状态可撤销已退款或取消的权益；离线设备无法实时得知退款。本版没有订阅或服务端购买验单系统。

sections.title: 5. 文字反馈
paragraphs: 只有填写文字、同意列明的上传内容并点击发送后，才会提交反馈。App 建立私有匿名 Firebase Authentication 标识，并将反馈正文、类别、提交编号、App 版本和构建号、系统及语言写入 Cloud Firestore。该技术标识不代表 App 登录，也不作为付费权益来源。认证及网络服务也可能处理 IP 和设备/网络信息。无需注册、提供邮箱或附加文件。请勿填写隐私信息或视频内容。
仅在服务端确认事务后显示已收到。网络结果不确定时保留本地草稿和稳定提交编号，供安全重试。请保留界面上的反馈编号以便支持或删除申请。客户端不能列出他人的反馈，也不能直接修改或删除已提交记录。

sections.title: 6. 保留与删除
paragraphs: 本地任务记录及 App 自有副本由应用内控件管理；相机原件及已导出的副本分别处理。卸载会按系统行为移除应用私有存储，请先保存需要的输出。
反馈计划在处理完成后删除，最长保留180天。Spark 首版由运营方人工管理删除，没有自动过期任务；匿名认证记录也需人工检查和删除。申请删除时联系 lusanyuss@gmail.com，并提供反馈编号与大致日期；请勿提供购买令牌或私人视频。卸载不会自动删除云端反馈。
Analytics事件和用户数据保留期已设为2个月，不因新增活动重置保留期；本属性的Google Signals、精细位置与设备收集和广告个性化均已关闭。Crashlytics、AdMob、Google Play和支持邮件按各自政策与配置保留信息。

sections.title: 7. 服务提供方、跨境与联系
paragraphs: Google服务可能在你所在国家以外的基础设施上处理数据；文字反馈存储在Cloud Firestore北美多区域nam5。服务SDK提供传输加密。压缩不上传媒体，也不申请设备定位权限。
本静态网站不含 App SDK、统计脚本或反馈表单；GitHub Pages 按其政策处理托管和网络日志。隐私联系：lusanyuss@gmail.com。服务提供者：北京晓目标科技有限公司。更新日期：2026-10-30。本文描述启用服务的 Android 方案；明确标为未配置的本地候选不会因此使不可用服务实际运行。

sections.title: 8. 年龄与可选服务
paragraphs: ClipReady面向13岁及以上用户，不面向13岁以下儿童。全部本地压缩功能免费，不要求注册、启用统计或发送反馈。开启Analytics或Crashlytics前，需另行确认已年满18岁；文字反馈也需确认年满18岁并同意列明的上传内容。未满18岁请保持这些可选服务关闭。Google Play按其规则管理购买账号、付款与监护人批准。如认为未成年用户提交了信息，请联系lusanyuss@gmail.com并提供反馈编号或相关日期，以便核查、删除我们控制的记录；请勿发送身份证件、私人视频或付款令牌。

terms.title: 服务条款
terms.summary: 功能范围、使用规则与当前收费状态。

sections.title: 1. 服务
paragraphs: 仅处理、保存和分享你拥有或已获授权使用的媒体，并遵守来源服务的条款。链接、格式支持和设备能力可能发生变化。

sections.title: 2. 本地文件
paragraphs: 请备份重要文件。处理可能改变大小、画质、元数据或兼容性；丢弃原片前请检查结果。本地结果不是云备份。

sections.title: 3. 收费与可用性
paragraphs: App 免费下载，全部本地压缩功能继续免费。启用服务的 Android 版本可提供非消耗型一次性购买以永久去除全部广告，无订阅。商店显示当地价格，并在付款前要求确认。待付款不授予去广告权益；恢复使用当前 Play 账号。退款和撤销在成功刷新商店状态后反映，离线时无法实时更新。销售取决于实际商品配置和地区。

sections.title: 4. 支持与更新
paragraphs: 支持及隐私请求请联系lusanyuss@gmail.com。服务或数据处理变化时，我们会更新相关说明。

deletion.title: 数据管理
deletion.summary: 管理本机数据、可选数据采集与支持请求。

sections.title: 本机数据
paragraphs: App 不提供注册或登录。使用应用内入口管理本地记录和自有文件。匿名反馈会建立私有云端标识并保存提交文字，与本地文件分别处理；卸载不自动删除反馈。

sections.title: 授权与请求
paragraphs: 在设置中分别关闭统计和崩溃报告，可停止后续可选采集。申请删除反馈或支持往来，请向 lusanyuss@gmail.com 发送反馈编号与大致日期，不要发送密码、购买令牌或私人媒体。我们按实际持有的数据核对处理。Play 购买记录及 Google 持有的 SDK 数据也适用其控制方式和政策。

sections.title: 联系我们
paragraphs: 请向lusanyuss@gmail.com发送问题、设备型号、系统和应用版本及复现步骤。
不要发送密码、验证码、Cookie、身份令牌或不必要的私人媒体。邮件由你主动发送，不自动上传诊断信息。
